findings: Unsafe DROP COLUMN without conditional check — COMPLETE_SCHEMA_FIX.sql attempts to drop Memberships.Status, Schedules.MemberId, Sessions.ActualStartTime/ActualEndTime/Notes, Checkins.SessionId/CheckinMethod, Members.Status/JoinDate without IF EXISTS guards. Second run fails with column does not exist errors.
Password hash mismatch risk — COMPLETE_SEED_DATA.sql includes hardcoded BCrypt hashes with WorkFactor 10. If the application uses different WorkFactor or algorithm, login fails for all seeded users.

Authorization bypass via missing MemberId claim — MembershipController.Cancel proceeds to CancelAsync for Admin/SuperAdmin even if userMemberId parse fails. Admin without MemberId claim can cancel any membership because service layer check passes when requestingMemberId is 0.

FK constraint rename may fail — COMPLETE_SCHEMA_FIX.sql queries sys.foreign_keys by name. If actual FK has auto-generated name, query returns NULL, constraint stays in place, subsequent ALTER COLUMN fails.

sp_rename may fail if source column doesn't exist — Lines like EXEC sp_rename 'Invoices.Amount', 'TotalAmount' assume source exists. If already renamed or never existed, sp_rename raises error and halts script.

Schedules datetime conversion loses time precision — COMPLETE_SCHEMA_FIX.sql converts ScheduledDate + StartTime to DATETIME2 by casting and adding. If StartTime or EndTime is NULL, result is NULL and ALTER COLUMN NOT NULL fails.
Master script uses sqlcmd-only syntax — RUN_COMPLETE_FIX.sql uses :r include directive not supported in SSMS, Azure Data Studio, or most SQL clients. Must run via sqlcmd command line.
Seed data INSERT column counts may mismatch schema — If schema fix fails partway through, seed data INSERT will fail with column does not exist. Schema must complete before seeding.

CancelAsync has no return value check — MembershipRepository.CancelAsync uses ExecuteAsync but doesn't check rowsAffected. If membership doesn't exist or already canceled, UPDATE matches zero rows and operation silently succeeds. Controller returns 200 OK even though nothing changed.

Frontend cancel button doesn't check membership ownership — wwwroot/js/memberships.js doesn't verify membership belongs to current user before showing cancel button. Member can manipulate DOM to call API with another member's membershipId. Backend rejects but user sees generic error.
Seed data creates future schedules but no past checkins context — 240 schedules for next 30 days but only 100 checkins over past 30 days. Admin dashboard stats skew toward future schedules.
